node.label: Lysosomal degradation (ceroid lipofuscin storage)
node.summary: Cells break down worn-out parts inside lysosomes. In all NCLs this recycling fails and waste (lipofuscin) builds up, especially in nerve cells.
node.description: [MOCK] Lysosomal catabolism of proteins and lipids; impairment leads to accumulation of autofluorescent storage material.
